# Index of Indexes

<!-- workspace-prose -->
This workspace holds four citation-backed wikis documenting Denmark's national clinical quality registries operated by RKKP (the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme) and its successor. Three are production wikis capturing the complete 2023 and 2024 annual reports from three separate registries: Rkkp Adhd tracks eleven quality indicators for childhood and adolescent ADHD care across Denmark's clinics and regions; Rkkp Afdk measures eight indicators for atrial fibrillation treatment and outcomes across 36 hospitals; and Rkkp Akdb monitors eleven quality metrics for acute high-risk abdominal surgery across all Danish hospital regions. The fourth wiki, Rkkp Danibd, documents the Danish National Quality Registry for Inflammatory Bowel Disease with seven clinical quality indicators and treatment patterns tracked across five healthcare regions. Each wiki extracts its source PDFs into four standard layers — documents (the raw report pages), entities (hospitals, regions, medications, and the healthcare professionals who deliver care), topics (quality indicators, clinical outcomes, regional variation, and evidence-based practices), and sources (provenance records) — so every clinical claim is traceable to its original page. Together, the workspace provides citation-backed coverage of four major disease areas in Danish healthcare quality measurement, each organized identically so a reader can navigate from one registry to another using the same structural logic.
<!-- /workspace-prose -->

## Wikis

- [[rkkp-adhd/index|Rkkp Adhd]] — Two annual reports (2023/24 and 2024/25) from Denmark's ADHD-databasen quality registry, published by RKKP and its successor Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut, covering the eleven numbered quality indicators for children and adolescents plus new adult indicators, tracked across clinics, regions, organizations, and the roughly 26 people who govern or deliver the care. A reader would open it to trace diagnosis, treatment, and coordination performance — including regional variation and clinic-level disparities — back to the exact source PDF pages behind each claim.
- [[rkkp-afdk/index|Rkkp Afdk]] — Denmark's national AFDK atrial fibrillation registry annual quality reports for 2023 and 2024, covering diagnosis, anticoagulation treatment, complications, and patient education across five regions, 21 sundhedsklynger, and 36 hospitals. It documents the eight core quality indicators (waiting times, echocardiography rates, stroke, bleeding, and heart-failure outcomes) alongside the hospitals, registries, and steering-group members behind them, cross-cutting themes like regional variation and data-quality caveats, and the raw document chunks and provenance hashes tying every reported figure back to its exact page in the source PDFs.
- [[rkkp-akdb/index|Rkkp Akdb]] — This wiki reproduces Denmark's Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) annual reports for 2023 and 2024, covering acute abdominal surgery quality data across 26 hospitals in five regions. It links indicator-level findings — antibiotic-timing compliance, CT-scanning, mobilisation, and 30-/90-day mortality by Charlson comorbidity band — to the hospitals, regions, and governing bodies (RKKP, Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) named in the reports, and traces each claim back to its exact source PDF page. Open it to check a specific mortality or indicator figure against its origin, or to see how methodology and data-quality topics recur across the two report years.
- [[rkkp-danibd/index|Rkkp Danibd]] — The 2023 and 2024 annual reports of Denmark's national quality registry for inflammatory bowel disease, documenting clinical care across 77 hospital departments in five regions through seven quality indicators, treatment patterns, patient demographics, and surgical outcomes — organized by the medications, hospitals, regions, and clinical measures that shape IBD care in Denmark.
